entry.label: Opening the Box
entry.description: A short dialogical introduction to systems thinking organised around four layers: parts and wholes, nascent development, coherence and metamorphosis, written to support transformative conversations.
aliases: Opening the Box: Systems Thinking for Transformative Conversations

profile.title: Opening the Box
profile.canonical_definition: A short dialogical introduction to systems thinking organised around four layers: parts and wholes, nascent development, coherence and metamorphosis, written to support transformative conversations.
profile.summary: Opening the Box is a compact, dialogical route into systems thinking through four proposed layers and a sustained challenge to surface-level explanation.
profile.why_it_matters: Its compact dialogical form gives readers a route into systems thinking without treating accessibility as a licence to flatten distinctions or remove uncertainty.
common_misreadings: the four layers are a complete ontology
open_checks: map the four layers to existing entries
profile.editorial_note: Developed from the cited public publication and practitioner sources. Open to correction, rival interpretation and stronger evidence.
